mapper.select: SELECT userId FROM users WHERE userId = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT hpId FROM hospital WHERE hpId=#{hpId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE userId = #{userId} AND state = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON u.userId=o.userId WHERE o.userId=#{userId} AND o.state=1 AND UPPER(COALESCE(o.patientIdentityCard,u.identityCard))=UPPER(#{identityCard})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (orderDate,userId,hpId,smId,state,patientType,patientName,patientSex,patientIdentityCard,patientBirthday,paymentStatus,paymentAmount) SELECT #{orderDate},#{userId},#{hpId},#{smId},1,#{patientType},#{patientName},#{patientSex},#{patientIdentityCard},#{patientBirthday},'UNPAID',price FROM setmeal WHERE smId=#{smId}
mapper.select: SELECT orderId,orderDate,userId,hpId,smId,state,patientType,patientName,patientSex,patientIdentityCard,patientBirthday,paymentStatus,paymentAmount FROM orders WHERE userId=#{userId} AND state=#{state} ORDER BY orderDate DESC,orderId DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET state=3, paymentStatus=CASE WHEN paymentStatus='PAID' THEN 'REFUNDED' ELSE 'CANCELLED' END WHERE orderId=#{orderId} AND userId=#{userId} AND state=1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cireport WHERE orderId=#{orderId})
